description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Ashcloud Phoenix triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield face down.
Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Ashcloud Phoenix face up.
Repeat.
